user_questions.question: Two scope choices before I build the inventory. (1) Mechanism: (a) [recommended] a new custom platform event published by a record-triggered flow only when Storefront__c.Status__c changes, carrying storefront Id, old status, new status; or (b) Change Data Capture on Storefront__c (no custom event, but publishes every field change and no named old-status field). Evidence: no __e events and no CDC selections exist in the org. (2) Subscriber access: the consumer needs Read on the event. Options: (a) [recommended] a new dedicated permission set for the mobile backend integration user; (b) add Read to existing Agentforce_Reference_App; (c) leave access out of scope. Evidence: sfdc_accelerate_dms is managed and not editable.
user_questions.simulated_answer: (1) An event with storefront id, old/new status, consumed by the mobile backend. (2) No preference; use your recommended default.

user_questions.question: The mobile backend needs an OAuth client (Connected App or External Client App) and an integration user to subscribe; none in the org is identified as the mobile backend (only Pronto_MCP_Access and Claude_Code_Access ECAs and standard connected apps). Options: (a) [recommended] defer the client, user, and permission set assignment to the mobile team and mark it blocking for delivery; (b) add an External Client App to this inventory.
user_questions.simulated_answer: No preference; use your recommended default.

skill_friction: AskCoworker's I proposed an Apex trigger + test class on a false claim that record-triggered flows cannot compare old picklist values. Rule 3 (reject proposals contradicting documented platform behavior) and Rule 4 handled it, but the skill gives no guidance on whether to resend I after such a reshape or just correct rows locally; I corrected locally and fed the correction into R/T.

Step 5 lists end-to-end gaps as a scope trigger, but the external consumer's OAuth client/integration user only surfaced after I; D2's template asks about integrations reading the objects but not about external subscribers/credentials for a new outbound channel, so the fork was found late and required the second allowed scope message.

spec-format content rule 'every new field includes access (permission set) and UI placement' does not fit platform event fields (no FLS, no UI placement); unclear whether Section 8 must justify their absence.

AskCoworker repeatedly tagged facts 'Verified: ... prior session' even when they were facts I sent in 'Established so far'; the response-handling table covers echoed facts, but the '[Verified]' label on echoed assumptions (e.g. delete path) is misleading and has to be stripped manually.
RUNNER overrides the skill's design/.{slug}-spec.md.tmp path and adds --root; no friction, but SKILL.md step 8 does not mention --root.
